Class Event

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.cards.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.model.cards.Event
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Event extends Card
Represents an Event card. Instances of this class are intended to be created from JSON data.

  • Constructor Details

    • Event

      public Event()
      Default constructor for Event. The constructor is empty as instances of this class will be populated using JSON deserialization.

    • Event

      public Event(Age age, String cardId, EventEffect effect, TriggerKey triggerKey, int resolutionPriority)
      Constructs a fully specified Event.
      Parameters:
      age - the age the event belongs to
      cardId - the JSON card id used for client-side image association
      effect - the effect executed when the event is discarded
      triggerKey - the key identifying when the event resolves
      resolutionPriority - the discard resolution priority (lower resolves first)

  • Method Details

    • getResolutionPriority

      public int getResolutionPriority()
      Returns the resolution priority of this event. Events with lower priority are resolved first during discard. Sustenance events have higher priority so they are resolved last.
      Overrides:

      Returns:
      The resolution priority.
